title: Facebook group, page and profile posts with comments
description: Collect public Facebook group, page, or personal profile posts, then enrich them with public comments and replies. The Actor orchestrates the feed and comment engines and returns one combined dataset.

startUrls.title: Facebook URLs
startUrls.description: Public Facebook group, page, or personal profile URLs. Group URLs and /people/ profile URLs are auto-detected; set userData.surfaceType for ambiguous handles. Large URL lists are processed in batches without silent truncation.

url.title: Facebook URL
url.description: Public Facebook group, page, or personal profile URL.

userData.title: Surface metadata
userData.description: Optional metadata used to force a specific Facebook surface type.

surfaceType.title: Surface type
surfaceType.description: Use group, page, or profile when auto-detection is ambiguous.

maxPostsPerGroup.title: Max posts per surface
maxPostsPerGroup.description: Maximum posts to collect from each group, page, or profile before comment enrichment. A run charge limit can reduce this value to keep collection within maxTotalChargeUsd.

sortMode.title: Feed sorting
sortMode.description: Facebook group feed order. Pages and personal profiles use newest-first feeds; CHRONOLOGICAL is recommended for group monitoring.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Inclusive lower date boundary. Supports ISO dates and relative values such as 30 days or 2 weeks.

onlyPostsOlderThan.title: Only posts older than
onlyPostsOlderThan.description: Exclusive upper date boundary: posts exactly at the boundary are excluded. Combine with onlyPostsNewerThan for a closed date range.

knownPostIds.title: Known post IDs
knownPostIds.description: Post IDs already stored by your pipeline. In chronological mode the feed can stop at a known post.

search.title: Post text filter
search.description: Case-insensitive post text filter applied before comment enrichment. Use searchMode=HISTORY_SCAN to scan history up to searchMaxPostsPerSurface instead of only filtering the latest feed snapshot.

searchMode.title: Search mode
searchMode.description: LOCAL filters the normal latest-post snapshot. HISTORY_SCAN walks backward through the public feed up to searchMaxPostsPerSurface and returns up to maxSearchResults matching posts. Facebook's signed-out search page requires login, so this is the no-cookie historical-search equivalent.

searchMaxPostsPerSurface.title: History scan depth
searchMaxPostsPerSurface.description: Maximum public posts walked per group, page, or profile when searchMode=HISTORY_SCAN.

maxSearchResults.title: Max matching posts
maxSearchResults.description: Maximum matching posts returned when searchMode=HISTORY_SCAN.

minComments.title: Minimum comments
minComments.description: Keep posts whose feed metadata reports at least this many comments. Posts with unknown engagement are kept.

minReactions.title: Minimum reactions
minReactions.description: Keep posts whose feed metadata reports at least this many reactions. Posts with unknown engagement are kept.

filterAuthor.title: Filter by post author
filterAuthor.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the public post author name or profile URL.

startCursor.title: Start cursor
startCursor.description: Cursor from a previous run's SUMMARY for an older-history backfill. Supported when startUrls contains exactly one group, page, or profile.

commentsMode.title: Comments mode
commentsMode.description: none: posts only. inline: up to 3 comments per post. full: collect full public comment threads with the configured limits.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum comment and reply rows collected for each post in full mode. Inline mode is capped at 3.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Expand public reply threads during full comment collection.

maxReplyThreadsPerPost.title: Reply threads per post
maxReplyThreadsPerPost.description: Maximum reply-bearing top-level comments to expand per post.

maxRepliesPerPost.title: Max replies per post
maxRepliesPerPost.description: Maximum reply rows collected per post in full mode.

commentsConcurrency.title: Comments concurrency
commentsConcurrency.description: How many posts the comment engine processes in parallel.

commentsSortOrder.title: Comment sorting
commentsSortOrder.description: Facebook comment order used by the comment engine.

unionSorts.title: Union comment sort windows
unionSorts.description: Walk both relevant and newest comment windows to improve public coverage.

onlyCommentsNewerThan.title: Only comments newer than
onlyCommentsNewerThan.description: Keep comments newer than an absolute date or relative value such as 30 days, 12 hours, or 2 weeks.

commentTextSearch.title: Comment text filter
commentTextSearch.description: Case-insensitive local filter over returned comment and reply text. It filters publicly collected comments and does not bypass signed-out Facebook limits.

minCommentReactions.title: Minimum comment reactions
minCommentReactions.description: Keep comments and replies with at least this many reactions.

includePostTextInCommentRows.title: Post text in comment rows
includePostTextInCommentRows.description: Include post_text in each returned comment row, including separate output mode.

commentsOutput.title: Comments output
commentsOutput.description: nested stores comments inside each post row. separate emits post rows and comment rows separately.

proxyTier.title: Proxy tier
proxyTier.description: Proxy behavior forwarded to the underlying group and comment engines.

proxyCountry.title: Proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Two-letter country code forwarded to page/profile engines.

dedupeStoreName.title: Comment dedupe store
dedupeStoreName.description: Stable logical Key-Value Store name used to return only new comments across scheduled runs. It is namespaced per Apify user internally, and the effective internal name is reported in SUMMARY.

failOnEmpty.title: Fail on empty
failOnEmpty.description: Mark the run failed when no posts are selected, or when no final output rows are produced. An existing post with zero public comments is still a valid output row.
